notes: Setup: npm run bootstrap failed immediately (Node.js 24+ required; sandbox Node v22.23.5, installing Node 24 was not permitted), so the documented fallback ran: git submodule update --init upstream/ffmpeg && npm ci (~7 s) && npm run reference:build (196 s).
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries and the 17 container-registry unit tests passed (89 s).
Native statuses tied to errno: the score-12 file is taken by bintext natively and fails with 256-EINVAL, computed from os.constants.errno on the host; EdgeFFmpeg refuses it at detection with exit 1.
No linux-gated cases: integer and byte-copy paths only.
Native comparisons ran only against the sandbox Linux x86_64 build, not the pinned macOS arm64 reference.

Audit follow-up (audit-fmt-a, macOS arm64 reference 946fcce0): declared rates from 2^30 Hz diverged in decoded framecrc pts (native 266 vs 256 at 2^30); now refused, with a differential regression test. Unit 6/6 and differential 4/4 pass on macOS arm64.
